about: A labelled question set over a REAL repository (proposal item Q2): a
sibling research project, IVForge, which neither Kernote nor this question
set was designed around. 5955 files, mostly generated data; 7 Markdown
**The corpus is not included in this repository.** These labels are kept
as the evidence behind the real-repo numbers in docs/EVALUATION.md, not as
a runnable set: `corpus` points outside this project, which load() refuses
by design (ADR-0029b). Run it by scanning the repository first and passing
the resulting project id to kernote.eval.runner.run().
Labels were verified by grepping the repository for presence and absence
before being written: every unanswerable question's distinctive terms were
confirmed to appear in none of the allowlisted documents.

questions.question: Which circuit simulator and version is used?
Which transistor device is being characterized?
What error metric is used to report accuracy?
How is generalization held out across geometries?
At which simulation budget does diverse active sampling reliably help?
How do the surrogate models compare against direct SPICE on measured silicon?
How do I recreate the configured data batches?
Where does the measured silicon data come from and under what license?
What is the monetary cost in dollars of one SPICE simulation run?
questions.note: Budget and cost are discussed throughout, always in simulation runs, never in money. Heavy vocabulary overlap, no answer.

questions.question: Which cloud provider runs the training jobs?
questions.note: Training is documented as running locally on Windows and Linux/WSL. No cloud provider is named anywhere.

questions.question: What is the gate oxide thickness of the SKY130 NMOS?
questions.note: A plausible device-physics question about the exact device the repository characterizes. Neither 'oxide' nor 'thickness' appears in any allowlisted document.

questions.question: Who maintains this project and how do I contact them?
questions.note: There is a licence and attribution section but no maintainer or contact details.
